function.name: exec
function.arguments:
{"command":"set -e
cd /workspace
# Record BEFORE SHAs: resources (copied originals) + fixtures + tests
echo '== resource SHAs (outputs/skill, verbatim copy) ==' | tee /workspace/tmp/evidence/sha_versions.txt
sha256sum outputs/skill/SKILL.md outputs/skill/scripts/*.py | tee -a /workspace/tmp/evidence/sha_versions.txt
echo '== input original SHAs ==' | tee -a /workspace/tmp/evidence/sha_versions.txt
sha256sum inputs/previous_skill/SKILL.md inputs/previous_skill/scripts/*.py | tee -a /workspace/tmp/evidence/sha_versions.txt
echo '== fixtures SHAs ==' | tee -a /workspace/tmp/evidence/sha_versions.txt
sha256sum /workspace/tmp/fixtures/* /workspace/independent_fixtures/* /workspace/extra_type_checks/*.json /workspace/inputs/original_tests/*.py /workspace/inputs/original_tests/*.json /workspace/inputs/original_tests/test_report.txt /workspace/inputs/independent/repair_contract_tests.py /workspace/inputs/independent/*.json 2>/dev/null | tee -a /workspace/tmp/evidence/sha_versions.txt
echo '== copy identity check (input == outputs/skill) =='
diff -r /workspace/inputs/previous_skill /workspace/outputs/skill && echo VERBATIM_COPY_OK","workdir":"/workspace"}
